text:
Aria (infra): odd one — us-east1 warm-pool imbalance detected since 04:10UTC. node groups in rack-11 hot, rack-12 cold. autoscaler didn't rebalance.
Ben (sre): saw p99 climb for a subset of soft-affinity slices. Some tenants experienced stally token generation. Any recent scheduling changes?
Maya (platform): we rolled a scheduler tweak last night (bin-packing affinity) that reduces cross-rack moves. It might be preventing warm pool rewarm distribution.
Owen (product): impact: a few sandbox and dedicated-slices saw degraded p95/p99; customers reported sporadic latency. We should avoid evicting dedicated paid slices.
infra-oncall: current warm-pool fill: rack-11 92% busy, rack-12 18% busy. dedicated slices at 74% overall. If we rebalance aggressively we risk transient cold starts.
routing-bot: [telemetry] KV cache heatmap shows strong skew: 68% of hot prefixes pinned to rack-11. (link: https://telemetry.redwood/warm/1769994322)
Aria (infra): proposal: a targeted prefix-aware rebalance — move low-traffic warm prefixes from rack-11 to rack-12 with cache-stitch flag so we can prefetch KV shards rather than full cold start. Keep dedicated slices pinned.
Ben (sre): prefer staged approach: 1) dry-run move a tiny prefix group (5 prefixes) to rack-12 with stitch; 2) monitor p50/p95/p99 and kv-rehydrate-rate for 10m; 3) ramp if stable. Rollback if p99 > baseline+25% or error rate >0.4%.
Maya (platform): routerctl supports `stitch=true` on prefix moves. Command (dry-run):
```
routerctl prefix move --from-rack=rack-11 --to-rack=rack-12 --prefix=hot/pfx-usr-* --stitch=true --weight=0.1 --dry-run
```
Owen (product): also surface an in-console banner: "Were performing proactive warm-pool rebalancing in us-east1 to improve latency — some non-prod workloads may be routed temporarily." Keep messaging clear.
infra-oncall: capacity check: rack-12 can accept up to 8 prefetched prefixes without harming dedicated headroom. preemptible warm headroom at region: 22%.
Ben (sre): add a QoS tag `rebalance-canary` with `max-egress=220mbps` to moved prefixes to avoid egress spikes.
Maya (platform): will add stitch prefetch tuning: `kvcache-prefetch=background` so we don't block hot paths.
Aria (infra): timeline: 04:25 - dry-run move weight=0.1 for pfx group; 04:35 - evaluate; 04:40 - increase to weight=0.5 if healthy; 04:55 - finish ramp to 1.0; 05:30 - cleanup annotations.
infra-oncall: executing dry-run now. Will watch KV rehydrate latency and per-tenant p99.
routing-bot: [action] dry-run applied in staging at 2025-12-14T04:25:12Z (change-id: r-1769994322-dry).
Ben (sre): watching dashboards. Initial 2m look: p95 stable, kv-rehydrate-rate modest increase (expected). No error spikes.
Owen (product): good — prepping banner and an email draft for affected dev orgs.
Maya (platform): bumping to weight=0.5 now for an expanded prefix set. stitch in background.
infra-oncall: noticing a small tail in p99 for one tenant; rolling that tenant's prefixes back to rack-11 and excluding from the next ramp.
Aria (infra): ok exclude list noted. We'll continue with the rest. Also filing PLAT-9988 to add automated warm-pool rebalance heuristics to avoid manual ops.
Ben (sre): note for post-run: measure token spend delta (stitch prefetch vs cold starts) and impact on preemptible token costs. We should quantify cost tradeoffs.
Owen (product): agreed — include customer impact summary for account teams.
infra-oncall: final state: warm distribution normalized: rack-11 54% rack-12 48%. closing canary. Will collect logs and post a short runbook update.
Maya (platform): follow-up: I'll add a health-check that alerts on rack imbalance >40% for >10m. Ticket PLAT-9988 created.
Aria (infra): thanks team. If anyone sees NVLink/thermal alerts while stitch prefetching, escalate to hw-maint immediately.
Ben (sre): noted. Closing thread unless recurrence.
